title: 2009 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement: On average, for every \(4\) sports cars sold at the local car dealership, \(7\) sedans are sold. The dealership predicts that it will sell \(28\) sports cars next month. How many sedans does it expect to sell?

solutions.text:
Set up the proportion \[ \dfrac{4}{7} = \dfrac{28}{x}. \] Cross-multiplying gives \[ 4x = 7 \cdot 28 \] and hence \[ x = 49. \]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Use the ratio \(4\) sports cars to \(7\) sedans.
Going from \(4\) to \(28\) sports cars multiplies by \(7.\)
